{{Quote|Grand Lord. It&hellip; has happened again&hellip; ''in Rabolow!''|A Lost Tribe uvak-rider, to Yaru Korsin, after the deaths in Rabolow|<ref name="paragon" />}}
'''Rabolow''' was a [[City/Legends|village]] near the [[Ragnos Lakes]] of the continent [[Keshtah Minor]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was one of eight towns in the region, including [[Tetsubal]]. In [[4985 BBY]], the entire population of Rabolow was [[Cyanogen silicate|poisoned]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by prominent [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] leader [[Seelah Korsin]], who framed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] [[Ravilan Wroth]] for the deed. As a result, Wroth and the rest of the members of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] in the Lost Tribe were [[Red Sith Purge|wiped]] from the face of Kesh. In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after, the abandoned Rabolow, along with the other towns of the region&mdash;which had suffered an identical fate at the hands of Korsin&mdash;was believed by many to be haunted.

==Description==
{{Quote|That's on the Ragnos Lakes, isn't it?|Seelah Korsin|<ref name="paragon" />}}
Rabolow was one of eight [[City/Legends|villages]] in the [[Ragnos Lakes]] region of the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]]<ref name="paragon" /> continent [[Keshtah Minor]].<ref name="secrets" /> Rabolow had a sizable [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] population.<ref name="paragon" />

==History==
{{Quote|That's where your people were assigned to go yesterday, wasn't it, Ravilan? Villages on the Ragnos Lakes.|Seelah Korsin, to Ravilan Wroth|<ref name="paragon" />}}
In [[4985 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yaru Korsin]], leader of Kesh's ruling faction, the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], sent a subordinate named [[Ravilan Wroth]] to the Ragnos Lakes region to investigate possible uses for a type of fluorescent algae being pulled from the lakes. However, Wroth, who harbored a deep desire for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to focus on leaving Kesh, took the opportunity to put into action a secret plan&mdash;in order to create the appearance of a deadly virus that would hopefully cause the Sith to withdraw from Keshiri society, Wroth decided to [[Poison/Legends|poison]] the [[Water/Legends|water]] supply of the village of [[Tetsubal]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the whole Keshiri population there.<ref name="paragon" />

While Wroth effected the deadly deed on Tetsubal, Rabolow was visited by members of Wroth's retinue. After the disaster at Tetsubal, Yaru Korsin's wife [[Seelah Korsin|Seelah]] discovered that Wroth's complicity in the deaths. Hoping to rid Kesh of Wroth and his like, Seelah decided to frame Wroth for similar deaths in other towns visited by his people. Rabolow was the first to fall victim to Seelah's plot, with the entire population killed, and news of the incident was brought to Yaru Korsin and Wroth by an [[Unidentified uvak-rider|uvak-rider]]. After the same fate was incurred on the other villages of the Ragnos Lakes, Wroth and the other members of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] in the Lost Tribe were systematically [[Red Sith Purge|purged]].<ref name="paragon" /> In the centuries after, the area of the Ragnos Lakes was entirely abandoned,<ref name="purgatory">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]''</ref> and by [[3960 BBY]] the region, including the ghost town of Rabolow, was commonly believed to be haunted.<ref name="sentinel">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Rabolow was first mentioned in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2010]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''.<ref name="paragon" />
